platforms.model: Claude Opus 4.7 positioned as its most capable public model for legal reasoning and long-document work
platforms.shape: Distribution play: ship the legal workflow layer inside Claude itself, and make every incumbent a connector into it.
components: 20+ MCP connectors into the software firms already run (DMS, CLM, e-discovery, research, deal rooms)
12 practice-area plugins: Commercial, Corporate, Employment, Privacy, Product, Regulatory, AI Governance, IP, Litigation, plus Law Student, Legal Clinic, Legal Builder Hub
Each plugin ships a cold-start interview that learns the team's playbook, escalation matrix and house style
4 plugins (Commercial, Corporate, Litigation, Product) also deploy as Managed Agents via the Claude API
Native in Microsoft 365 — Word (drafting/redlining), Outlook (triage), Excel (checklists), PowerPoint
Claude Cowork for multi-document work; Projects as persistent matter workspaces; scheduled tasks for recurring sweeps
platforms.access: Enterprise via sales; discounted access for qualifying nonprofits through Claude for Nonprofits; A2J partnerships with Free Law Project and the Justice Technology Association

platforms.model: GPT-6 Astra, configured for legal work — not a separate model

components: Legal Search Index across 230M+ URLs of US case law, statutes, regulations, court rules and administrative decisions, built using CourtListener data
Legal-specific instructions for analysis and writing
26 vendor plugins plus 9 community plugins (LegalQuants, LegalEng Consulting Group, Skills.law) and 47 user-built skills

Trusted Access program for Am Law 200 firms: zero data retention on the API, ChatGPT Enterprise excluded from human review; built with Latham & Watkins on permissions and ethical walls (~30-page agreement)
platforms.benchmarks: Passed correctness evals on 54% of legal research questions vs 38.7% for GPT-6 with web search alone; retrieved 24% more case law references and up to 54% more relevant passages
platforms.people: Jason Boehmig, Ironclad co-founder, leads OpenAI's legal effort

platforms.shape: Integration play: don't own the workflow, be the substrate the firm's existing stack runs agents on. Sold through SIs.
components: Legal-specific skills and pre-built agents for contract review, diligence, regulatory monitoring and privacy requests
Connectors into DMS, e-discovery and legal research systems with existing permissions preserved
First industry-specific packaging of Gemini Enterprise, alongside a financial services edition; healthcare and life sciences flagged as next
App-layer partners joined at launch, Legora among them — Google is packaging the ecosystem rather than replacing it
